shots.purpose: Show one coherent experiment: Wi-Fi and Mobile chambers receive identical data objects, then behavior diverges

hero.visualDescription: one connected cyber-lab apparatus with two transparent vertical chambers on a shared platform
hero.referenceGeometry: two tall rounded chambers connected by one base

shots.framing: single centered hero object over cyberspace brand foundation
shots.composition: one hero, one message, no mascot
text: НА WI-FI РАБОТАЕТ / НА МОБИЛЬНОЙ СЕТИ — ИНАЧЕ / VPN ТОТ ЖЕ
shots.visualChange: both sides begin similarly; mobile side gradually slows and dims selected route activity
shots.transitionReason: the same physical setup reveals the changed variable

shots.purpose: Let DEVICE, VPN, NETWORK labels appear one by one at natural speech pace

hero.visualDescription: environmental engraving on the shared base: DEVICE SAME, VPN SAME, NETWORK CHANGED

shots.framing: same twin chamber, slightly closer platform view
shots.composition: labels evolve the same object rather than introducing a new hero
text: УСТРОЙСТВО ТО ЖЕ / VPN ТОЖЕ / МЕНЯЕТСЯ СЕТЬ
shots.visualChange: focus advances from DEVICE to VPN to NETWORK
shots.transitionReason: NETWORK CHANGED points camera toward internal conditions

shots.purpose: Explain that VPN is only part of the route and network conditions also affect the result

hero.visualDescription: Wi-Fi side keeps more active routes; Mobile side has fewer or slower active routes without error marks

shots.composition: one thesis at a time over the same apparatus
text: VPN — ТОЛЬКО ЧАСТЬ МАРШРУТА / СЕТЬ ТОЖЕ МЕНЯЕТ РЕЗУЛЬТАТ
shots.visualChange: route movement and brightness clarify different conditions
shots.transitionOut: slow pull back to full apparatus
shots.transitionReason: returning to full view prepares the final diagnostic question

shots.purpose: Return to the full twin chamber and leave a calm diagnostic question

hero.visualDescription: same apparatus remains on screen with small environmental GhostPepeBot branding
hero.referenceGeometry: two connected chambers and shared base

shots.composition: final thesis, no end card, no CTA button
text: ПРОВЕРЯЙ НЕ ТОЛЬКО VPN / ПРОВЕРЯЙ В КАКОЙ ТЫ СЕТИ
shots.visualChange: routes settle while the final question holds
shots.transitionReason: the ending remains inside the experiment rather than cutting to a brand card
